svg.title: The oracle screen, recreated as a wireframe
svg.desc: A wireframe of the oracle's desktop window, laid out from measurements of a screenshot of 8 November 2026, with a plain circle standing in for the bot's avatar. It plays one turn in a 20 second loop: a message is typed and sent, the bot says it will check, one working line at the bottom reads Checking the storage while the Computer card wakes, replies arrive above it and the conversation scrolls up, a picture grid loads, the line changes to Saving to Library, and a dot lands on the Library tab. Timing is guessed, not yet measured on the oracle (H7). With reduced motion it shows the finished turn, still. Generated by scripts/generate-hero.mjs.
